data.why: CesiumAstro announced a new manufacturing facility in Melbourne, Florida less than a month ago. As Corporate Controller, expanding production infrastructure directly increases Sanjiv's supplier invoice volume and month-end close complexity.
data.angle: Reconciling new equipment purchase orders, supplier invoices, and close workflows stemming from a new manufacturing facility.

not_chosen.reason: Awkward: This is an open job posting for the prospect's own role as Corporate Controller.
Bad news: Industry supply chains struggling to keep up highlights operational difficulties.
Funding amounts conflict across sources ($630M in s7 vs $730M in news reports), and major funding rounds attract heavy cold outreach.
The space defense startup acquisition headline omits the target's name and is less tangible for everyday supplier workflows than a new factory.
Company-wide headcount growth is generic compared to the concrete launch of a new manufacturing plant.

data.subject: melbourne facility
data.body:
Hi Sanjiv,

Saw CesiumAstro is adding a manufacturing facility in Melbourne, Florida.

Standing up a new production site usually brings a wave of new supplier contracts, equipment POs, and invoices to reconcile at month-end. Who is matching all those POs to supplier invoices today?

Block cut 75% of manual steps in its close with Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
